digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality test and inbound mapper module organization
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain rooted at the reconciler package level because Data Center and Cloud adapters share it while J7 forbids sibling-adapter imports between jira/ and jira_datacenter/
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would violate the J7 sibling-adapter seal by allowing jira_datacenter to import from jira/
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core importers (inbound_differ.py and peer_state.py) are not permitted to consume the jira_family layer
the module's by-path lazy-load of adapters/jira/adf.py cannot be routed through a shared jira_family layer without laundering the AST gate
the backend-neutrality sweep exemption documents a deliberate architectural cost rather than temporary debt, justified by the shared mapper keeping the J7 seal intact
